subject: Medisync — questionnaire path, SOC2/HIPAA clarifications and next steps
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <security@medisync.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 15:23:00 +0000
Subject: Medisync — questionnaire path, SOC2/HIPAA clarifications and next steps

Hi Emily,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for taking time with the discovery call. Quick recap from our side and a few clarifying asks so we can get the questionnaire started: 

Recap / asks:
- Preferred questionnaire: you mentioned CAIQ during the call. Can you confirm whether you want us to prefill CAIQ or do you prefer the SIG excel? Either works, we can prefill both if easier (we typically prefill CAIQ + attach SOC2 artifacts).
- SOC 2 status: can you confirm Medisync requires Redwood to provide SOC 2 Type II? We can provide our latest SOC 2 summary; Karthik will attach a short summary and architecture diagram.
- HIPAA / PHI scope: you noted some workflows will touch PHI. Can you confirm which product surface(s) will process PHI (API ingestion, embeddings storage, etc.) and whether you need a BAA?
- Data residency & retention: what are your retention expectations for request logs and model inputs? Any region restrictions?
- Timeline & next steps: what target date would you like the questionnaire completed by? Our working assumption for enterprise reviews is ~10 business days if you provide a filled CAIQ; if you want us to prefill, add ~3–4 business days.

If you can send the CAIQ/SIG template or point us to a shared link, Karthik will start prefill work. I’ve attached two short artifacts for quick context (SOC2 summary + architecture overview).

Proposed immediate next steps (suggested):
1) You send the CAIQ/SIG template (or confirm CAIQ preference) + any specific evidence locations.
2) Karthik will prefill CAIQ where possible and flag open evidence items.
3) Kickoff call (30 min) with your security and our security eng to walk any HIPAA-specific flows.

Thanks — I’ll leave the technical questions to Karthik below.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (summary, 2 pages)
- redwood-architecture-overview.pdf (diagram, 1 page)

From: Emily Park <security@medisync.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@medisync.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0600
Subject: Re: Medisync — questionnaire path, SOC2/HIPAA clarifications and next steps

Hi Soojin — thanks for the recap and the quick artifacts. A few notes from our side: 

1) Questionnaire preference: CAIQ would be preferred; we can accept a prefilled CAIQ but will still want to see supporting evidence (SOC2, architecture, config screenshots). We’ll upload our CAIQ template to a shared Drive link by EOD today.

2) SOC 2: Medisync requires vendor SOC2 Type II for production integrations. If Redwood can provide the latest SOC2 report (summary + control matrix) that will help speed review. The summary you attached looks helpful — we may request the full report under NDA later.

3) HIPAA: yes, some flows will contain PHI (clinical notes ingestion and certain API calls). We will require a signed BAA before PHI goes live. Please let us know if Redwood has a standard BAA or if you need our template.

4) Data residency: production data will reside in us-east-1 only; logs should be retained for 12 months. We will flag any divergence.

Tentative timeline: if Redwood can prefill CAIQ and provide SOC2 artifacts, we aim to complete the security review within 10 business days of receiving materials. We have a security sync window next week — Wed 11/18 14:00–15:00 ET or Thu 11/19 11:00–11:30 ET — either works for a quick kickoff.

I attached a short intake doc to show our internal mapping (pdf).

Emily Park
Security Lead, Medisync
security@medisync.com

Attachments:
- medisync-security-intake.pdf (intake mapping)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <security@medisync.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Medisync — questionnaire path, SOC2/HIPAA clarifications and next steps

Hi Emily / Soojin — thanks for the details. A few technical clarifications from our side so we can prefill accurately: 

- CAIQ prefill approach: we can prefill the CAIQ with standard infrastructure/control responses and link to SOC2 artifacts. Please confirm whether you want us to mark items as "attestation" vs "evidence" (we typically mark as attestation + reference to an evidence bundle).

- PHI handling: for flows that contain PHI, Redwood supports a BAA. We have a standard BAA template (link below) but can review Medisync’s version if you prefer.

- Data processing specifics: can you confirm whether embedding storage will be considered PHI by your legal team? If yes, we recommend using token redaction on ingress or using a dedicated private deployment (we can discuss).

- Key management: Redwood supports customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) for Dedicated/Private deployments. For hosted API, we encrypt at rest with provider-managed keys by default; we can discuss Bring-Your-Own-Key options if required.

- Evidence requests: which specific artifacts do you expect in the first pass? Common asks we see: SOC2 summary, network diagram, IAM policy screenshot (console), vulnerability scan summary, encryption config doc, and incident response plan excerpt. If you can prioritize top 5 we’ll surface those first.

We’ll start the prefill as soon as we have the CAIQ template or the SIG spreadsheet. Proposed next step: Emily uploads CAIQ to the Drive link and we’ll take ownership of prefill. If you prefer a joint 30-min kickoff to walk HIPAA flows, either Wed 11/18 14:00 ET or Thu 11/19 11:00 ET works for our team.

Links: https://redwood.internal/docs/BAA-template-v2

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Attachments included by me for initial prefill: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, redwood-architecture-overview.pdf

From: Emily Park <security@medisync.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Medisync — questionnaire path, SOC2/HIPAA clarifications and next steps

Thanks Karthik — I uploaded our CAIQ template and a short evidence checklist here: https://drive.google.com/medisync/CAIQ-template-uptake

We prefer you prefill CAIQ (attestation + evidence refs). For the first pass please prioritize: SOC2 report (summary + matrix), network diagram, encryption at rest config, IAM role screenshots, and an RS vulnerability scan report.

On BAA: we’ll send our BAA draft to legal@medisync.com — if Redwood can share your standard BAA in the next 24 hours that’d help speed the legal review.

I can take the Wed 11/18 14:00 ET slot for a kickoff. Please send an invite and we’ll loop in one engineer and one legal person.

Emily
